import json
import pdf_ops

PAGE = 3
TARGET_TEXT = 'It its first year'
NEAR = [381.99, 610.89, 442.35, 622.8]
REPLACEMENT = 'In its first year'

doc = pdf_ops.open("input.pdf")
target = pdf_ops.find_target(doc, PAGE, TARGET_TEXT, near=NEAR)

ok, missing = pdf_ops.glyphs_available(target.font, REPLACEMENT)
if not ok:
    raise pdf_ops.MissingGlyphsError("characters missing from the embedded font", missing)
BOUNDARY = 571.048  # right edge from the plan; never past it
fit = pdf_ops.fit_horizontal(doc, target, REPLACEMENT, BOUNDARY)
if not fit.feasible:
    raise pdf_ops.DoesNotFitError(fit.reason)
result = pdf_ops.expand_horizontal(doc, target, REPLACEMENT, boundary=BOUNDARY)
pdf_ops.save(doc, "output.pdf")
print(json.dumps(result.to_dict()))
